Project Summary

This project is an R package that provides a modern, user-friendly implementation of the "Equating Recipes" program, originally written in C by Robert L. Brennan, Tianyou Wang, Seonghoon Kim, and Jaehoon Seol. "Equating Recipes" is a comprehensive set of functions for performing various psychometric equating methods, as described in the book "Test Equating, Scaling, and Linking: Methods and Practices" by Kolen and Brennan (2004).

The R package will make these powerful equating methods more accessible to the R community, providing a robust and well-documented tool for researchers, psychometricians, and assessment professionals. It will cover a wide range of equating designs, methods, and smoothing techniques, mirroring the extensive functionality of the original C program.

R-Equating-Recipes

R-Equating-Recipes is an R package that implements the test equating procedures from the "Equating Recipes" C program. This package provides a comprehensive set of tools for psychometric equating, making the methods described in Kolen and Brennan's "Test Equating, Scaling, and Linking: Methods and Practices" (2004) accessible within the R environment.

Overview

Test equating is a statistical process used in psychometrics to ensure that scores from different forms of a test are comparable. "Equating Recipes" was developed to provide open-source functions for a wide variety of equating procedures, enhancing transparency and providing valuable tools for researchers. This R package aims to continue that mission by providing a modern, easy-to-use implementation of these methods.

Features

This package provides a comprehensive set of functions for various equating designs, methods, and smoothing techniques, including:

Equating Designs:

    Random Groups (RG) 

Single Group (SG) 

Common-Item Nonequivalent Groups (CNEG) 

Equating Methods:

    Mean and Linear Equating 

Equipercentile Equating 

Item Response Theory (IRT) Equating 

Smoothing Methods:

    Beta-Binomial Presmoothing 

Log-Linear Presmoothing 

Cubic Spline Postsmoothing 

Kernel Equating 

Continuized Log-Linear Equating 

Standard Error Estimation:

    Delta Method 

Bootstrap 

Installation

You can install the development version of R-Equating-Recipes from GitHub with:
R

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("your-username/R-Equating-Recipes")

Example

Here is a basic example of how to perform linear equating with the random groups design:
R

library(eqr)

# Load example data for Form X and Form Y
data("act_math")

# Perform linear equating
equated_scores <- equate_linear_rg(
  x_scores = act_math$form_x_scores,
  x_freq = act_math$form_x_freq,
  y_scores = act_math$form_y_scores,
  y_freq = act_math$form_y_freq
)

# View the equated scores
print(equated_scores)
